description: Retrieve a manufacturer's phone, email and street addresses by its 11-digit ABN. Requires an active Australian Manufacturing Directory Business API key; subscribe at https://ausmanufacturingdirectory.com/membership. Each authorized lookup of an existing company consumes daily call and record allowance and updates usage counters, including repeated lookups. Does not modify supplier records or contact the company. Returns 401 for invalid access, 429 when the daily allowance is exhausted (resets midnight UTC), or an error for an unknown ABN.
name: get_contact_details
title: Get manufacturer contact details
